items.title: Mailbox status says what actually works
items.detail: One rule (src/mailStatus.ts) using the server's readiness check: Working, Receiving only, No mail arriving yet, Not set up, Sign in needed.

items.title: All mail folder
items.detail: Every account and tab in one list, archived too, never spam or trash. /mail/all.

items.title: Sorting rules editor
items.detail: Settings, Mail: taught senders, change or remove, add for an address or @domain. Phone: in Inbox settings.

items.title: Shared inbox access levels
items.detail: Can read / Can read and send per person, enforced on the server and for mail apps. 'Private from admins' left out: admins control the list, so it can't be promised.

items.title: Backup sign-in email
items.detail: Settings, Account, Security. Signs in and gets reset codes; a reset keeps the main email.

items.title: Chat summary: one brief you can update
items.detail: Overview, Urgent, Decided, Open questions, Next steps; Update button, 'N new messages since'. Dated summaries folded below.

items.title: Home layout fully customizable
items.detail: Exact card sizes, more columns, add any card, balanced spacing.

items.title: Bottom bar: margins, safe areas, rounded
items.detail: Floating bar, inset from edges, follows phone corner curves, rethink labels.

items.title: Landing page audit and rewrite
items.detail: Who it's for in the hero, two CTAs, agency and free guests up front, no endless marquee.

items.title: Brands inside a workspace
items.detail: Settings, General & email, Brands: name, colour, logo, domains. Mailboxes on a brand's domains get its colour dot; compose names the brand. Next: brand signatures (with R7).

items.title: Domain step: buying a domain (needs your call)
items.detail: Connecting your own domain already works in onboarding (keep / mix / hosted with live DNS checks). Buying one needs a registrar account (e.g. a reseller API) and payments: your decision.

items.title: One interface for guests and team (needs your call)
items.detail: Changes how the client portal walls off client data. Proposal in docs/GAMEPLAN.md section 8; worth deciding together before building.

items.title: Own persona, not copied. Look like the landing page / elkiya.com / elkiyagroup.com
items.detail: Raw: Settings feels copied from Apple settings. No persona yet. Brand consistent across the whole app, like the landing page or Elkiya.

items.title: No dead grey background: white, bright
items.detail: Raw: don't like the grey background, makes the app look dead. Likes white and bright colours.

items.title: Research each app against its reference
items.detail: Raw: Mail = Gmail/Proton UI, Chat = Slack + Discord, Tasks = Todoist, Calendar = Google Calendar, Projects = ?, Meet = Read AI, Drive = Google Drive, Notes = notes, Tables = Notion database, Teams = team management, Vault = passwords, Settings = settings. Round 3 compared every app with its reference; 60+ findings. Projects: Basecamp recommended (built for agencies with clients).

items.title: Right-click on everything
items.detail: Raw: right-click a feature to hide it (e.g. hide Chat if not used), then a menu to show it again. Most things should have a right-click menu, only a few do now. Rounds 2: rail apps, projects, teams, meetings, tables, mail folders. More in later rounds.

items.title: Inbox tabs should be removable (like Gmail labels)
items.detail: Raw: Primary/Promotions/Social/Updates feel default, should be able to cancel them out if not wanted.

items.title: Filter chips cropped (Attachments cut off)
items.detail: Raw: Unread / Needs reply / Assigned to me / Attachments row gets cropped when the list isn't wide, can't reach Attachments.

items.title: Signature designer with ~5 templates
items.detail: Raw: design a signature, add logo etc. 5 templates. Free plan has a watermark, paid removes it.

items.title: Amazon SES: cost, what customers get free
items.detail: Raw: we talked about SES but don't use it. How much does it cost us, is it expensive to provide, how many free per month? Back-end logic needed (message cut off).

items.title: Submit a ticket, queue in the admin backend
items.detail: Raw: feature to submit a ticket that goes to the backend, see which tickets need processing.

items.title: Final: full security audit (vibe-coded app risks) + Dokploy
items.detail: Raw: make sure ENVs, APIs etc. never reach the front end. List the usual vibe-code security mistakes and check all. Look at Dokploy for what else to protect. Research GitHub/Google. Final backlog after the 5 rounds.

items.title: Five audit rounds, 15+ items each, UX/UI first
items.detail: Raw: audit, 15-20 backlog items, fix, audit again, five times (75+). Customer-centric, UX/UI first, features second. Question every placement against common habits on phone and desktop. Open to removing features nobody uses.

items.title: Same background on phone and desktop (white, not reversed)
items.detail: Raw: white is better than grey. On mobile the background is white, on desktop a grey off-white, reversed, feels inconsistent.

items.title: Phone should feel as clean as desktop
items.detail: Raw: desktop UI is pretty clean but the phone doesn't reflect its similarities.

items.title: Keep the 'Try it' demo
items.detail: Raw: thought about removing the demo, decided to keep it.

items.title: Side drawer slides out the way it came in
items.detail: Duplicate s2gDrawerOut keyframes made the left drawer fade right on close.

items.title: Home shows the launcher button, not a back arrow
items.detail: Home is a main screen; a back chevron implied it was pushed.

items.title: Chat bottom tab: Channels, not Home
items.detail: "Home" clashed with the Home app.

items.title: Drive: Recent, not Home
items.detail: Two different screens named Home inside one app.

items.title: Meet rows: quiet notetaker toggle, distinct create button
items.detail: Stacks of identical orange mic circles; unclear which one does what.

items.title: Bottom bar and create button on the z-index tokens
items.detail: Hard-coded 34/35; the bar could draw over the button mid-animation.

items.title: Month picker shows neighbouring days, muted
items.detail: First and last rows looked broken with blank cells.

items.title: Filter chips never cropped
items.detail: Attachments chip was cut off in a narrow list (R6).

items.title: Inbox tabs keep one width; new-mail dot takes no space
items.detail: Tabs resized when you picked one; the highlight jumped.

items.title: Read and unread rows keep the same width
items.detail: Bold-on-unread shifted text when an email was opened.

items.title: Row hover actions without a box, date not hidden
items.detail: Box inside a box covering the date.

items.title: Done has one icon everywhere
items.detail: Check in some places, archive box in others.

items.title: Empty list says why, with the right icon
items.detail: A big tick showed for searches that found nothing.

items.title: Discarding a draft can be undone
items.detail: One tap lost everything typed.

items.title: Today agrees with Home
items.detail: "All done for today" while Home listed things that need you.

items.title: One name for the notetaker; real call icons
items.detail: Five names for one feature; every non-Zoom call labelled GM.

items.title: One primary button per empty screen
items.detail: Header and empty state both had the same primary button.

items.title: No developer instructions shown to users
items.detail: Vault told end users to run npm run server.

items.title: Unknown Settings page says so, not "Ask an admin"
items.detail: /settings/general showed a permission message.

items.title: Dated summaries never hang on an AI error
items.detail: An AI failure left it on "Writing…" forever.

items.title: After the 5 rounds: audit every app twice (15-20 items each)
items.detail: Raw: audit mail 2x, chat 2x, tasks 2x, vault 2x, projects 2x, every menu, 15-20 backlog each time. Customer experience on mobile, desktop and iPad (portrait and landscape). Very comprehensive.

items.title: Inboxes as a dropdown account switcher
items.detail: Raw: instead of every email listed under Inboxes, a dropdown to pick which account to see (All or one), plus Add temporary address and Add a (non-temporary) address in the same dropdown.

items.title: White pages everywhere, panels set apart by fine edges
items.detail: Same white on phone and desktop; Elkiya ink and soft blue glow. (R2, R13)

items.title: Right-click an app to hide it; + brings hidden apps back
items.detail: The rail menu: Open, Hide; a "+N hidden" button lists hidden apps. (R4)

items.title: Inbox picker instead of a long list
items.detail: All inboxes, each mailbox with unread and problems, temporary addresses, add an address. (R16)

items.title: Right-click a project card
items.detail: Open, Open tasks, Email the project, Pause, End.

items.title: Right-click a team card
items.detail: Open, Open team tasks, Rename, Delete.

items.title: Right-click a meeting row
items.detail: Open, Share, Ask about it, File in project, Delete: the detail screen's actions.

items.title: Right-click a table card, and board cards on desktop
items.detail: Board card menu was phone-only. Done for table cards (Open, Copy link). Board cards on desktop need the table screen's row actions passed in: next round.

items.title: Right-click a folder
items.detail: Mark all read, Empty (Trash, Spam).

items.title: One header style, sentence case, phone and desktop
items.detail: 11px uppercase on desktop, 13px uppercase on phone; the system says 15/600 sentence case.

items.title: Phone Settings: our look, not iOS's coloured tiles
items.detail: Plain icons like desktop; no rainbow of tiles.

items.title: Phone Settings opens with the company card
items.detail: Logo, name, plan: what you are setting, at the top. No change: the company group is already titled with the company name.

items.title: Grouped cards follow the theme tokens in dark mode
items.detail: Hard-coded #1c1c1f.

items.title: Settings nav and blocks on the spacing scale
items.detail: 9px radius, 26px gaps: off the scale. Header style unified (B9); nav radii left as they are, within 1 px of the token.

items.title: Phone shows each section's intro
items.detail: The explanatory line was hidden on phones.

items.title: One tablet breakpoint in JS and CSS
items.detail: JS 1099 vs CSS 1100: at 1100 px both rules applied.

items.title: iPad landscape: room for the reader in Mail
items.detail: 248 sidebar + 72 rail + 400 list left ~470 px.

items.title: Home cards go full width on every phone width
items.detail: 760 vs 767: half-width cards on some phones.

items.title: Chat details dock beside the conversation from 1024 px
items.detail: It covered the conversation up to 1100 px. No change: details float over the conversation below 1440 px on purpose (polish.css), so it never squeezes.

items.title: Side panels leave room on iPad portrait
items.detail: 520 px panel left a 176 px sliver. No change: a 520 px panel over a dimmed list is iPad's slide-over pattern.

items.title: A second window follows the first (compose, folder)
items.detail: Seen tonight: with two windows open as the same person, opening a draft in one opened the same compose and folder in the other. Not reproducible with one window; needs a second window to trace (look at live sync of threads and any draft/compose state).

items.title: Archive, not Done (Gmail and Proton's word and icon)
items.detail: Hover, bulk bar, phone bar, reader, swipes, shortcut sheet, toasts. Reverses A12: you named Gmail as the reference.

items.title: Hover actions in Gmail's order, with Read/Unread
items.detail: Archive, Delete, Read/Unread, Snooze.

items.title: Swipes archive both ways by default
items.detail: Gmail's default; snooze stays a choice in Settings.

items.title: @mentions show in muted channels
items.detail: Muting quiets chatter, not you (Slack, Discord).

items.title: Jump to recent
items.detail: A pill above the composer when you're far up the history.

items.title: One-click reactions on hover; Make a task moved to More
items.detail: Slack's hover bar.

items.title: Undo after completing a task
items.detail: Todoist's "1 task completed · Undo"; Undo restores the exact stage.

items.title: My tasks: no Inbox icon
items.detail: In Todoist Inbox means unfiled tasks.

items.title: Q opens quick add
items.detail: Todoist's shortcut, next to N.

items.title: Desktop New menu (upload, new folder)
items.detail: Desktop had no way to make a folder.

items.title: Desktop right-click has share link, download, move
items.detail: Same actions as the phone sheet.

items.title: Empty Drive on phones says tap +
items.detail: It said "press Upload", which phones don't have.

items.title: Bot log only when a recording failed
items.detail: Diagnostics out of sight (Read AI); in the meeting's menu otherwise.

items.title: "Action items", one name
items.detail: Was "Tasks" in one place and "Action items" in another.

items.title: Lock button and auto-lock after 15 minutes idle
items.detail: 1Password and Bitwarden do.

items.title: Honest encryption wording; chip only on logins needing re-save
items.detail: The sidebar contradicted the end-to-end claim.

items.title: Team name and description save on leaving the field, never empty
items.detail: Saved on every keystroke; an empty name could be saved.

items.title: Colour badge opens a picker
items.detail: It cycled colours on click, which read as a bug.

items.title: Empty states that are true
items.detail: "First line is the title" was wrong; filtered views offer Show all notes.

items.title: Internal notes say so on the box
items.detail: "Internal note · only your team sees it", above the comment field next to Reply.

items.title: A replies to all; L (label) listed
items.detail: Gmail's keys.

items.title: @mention autocomplete like Slack
items.detail: Any word of a name, any language's letters, the conversation's people first, arrows and Tab.

items.title: Search on desktop
items.detail: Phones had it; desktop didn't.

items.title: Grouped Active / Leads / Paused, in name order
items.detail: Cards no longer reshuffle as tasks go late (Basecamp's way).

items.title: Find a project
items.detail: Search field once there are more than six.

items.title: One New project button
items.detail: The sidebar's; the header copy is gone.

items.title: One New team button; tabs Tasks and Who's busy
items.detail: "Work" next to "Workload" read as the same thing.

items.title: Date sections on desktop
items.detail: Today, Previous 7 days, months: as on the phone and in Apple Notes.

items.title: Signature designer (R7)
items.detail: 5 layouts, brand logo and colour, live preview, Use this signature. Free plan adds "Sent with sprint2go".

items.title: Tables allowed in email HTML
items.detail: Designed signatures (and most designed emails) use tables; they can't run anything.

items.title: Signature logos reach Gmail and Outlook
items.detail: Uploaded as a company file so the mail engine attaches it; SVG logos are left out and explained.

items.title: Google Calendar's view order on computers
items.detail: Day, Week, Month, Schedule, 3 days; phones keep Schedule first.

items.title: p1 to p4 in quick add say what they become
items.detail: p1-p2 high, p3-p4 normal; the chip names it.

items.title: Tickets (R9): already built
items.detail: Help & support files tickets with replies and ratings; the queue is at /admin/tickets.

items.title: Amazon SES costs (R8)
items.detail: docs/SES-COSTS.md: about $0.10 per 1,000 emails; the risk is reputation, not price.
